base_url.description: Base URL used to generate client-facing endpoints. Must end with a slash.

listen.description: Interface IP or hostname to bind to. Empty string binds to all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port to listen on for incoming HTTP requests.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP connections allowed.

max_response_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of the HTTP response body. Larger responses will be rejected.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for HTTPS support.

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required when SSL is enabled).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (required when SSL is enabled).

client_subnets.description: List of allowed client subnets (in CIDR notation). Only clients from these subnets may connect.

items.description: Allowed client subnet in CIDR format (e.g., 10.0.0.0/24)

ip_pool.description: IP address range (CIDR or start-end format) to assign to connecting clients.

dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers to push to clients. If empty, system default DNS is used.

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 DNS server address

syslog_enabled.description: Log to system syslog instead of file.

log_level.description: Verbosity of server logging. Valid values: debug, info, warning, error.

log_file.description: Path to log file (used only if syslog_enabled = false).

request_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for HTTP request processing before connection is dropped.

workers.description: Number of worker processes. Use 0 for single-process mode (no forking).

state_file.description: Path to file storing persistent state (e.g., assigned client IPs).

debug_verbose.description: Enable extremely verbose debugging output (for troubleshooting only).

mtu.description: Maximum Tunnel MTU in bytes (set lower than underlying link MTU to avoid fragmentation).

client_config_template.description: Optional path to Jinja2 template used to generate per-client configuration files.
